This decision forced an unnecessary and inefficient information gathering process that led to incomplete data retrieval (in the viewport) and subsequent hallucination in the final answer. Had the Planner used internal knowledge (or verified capability constraints), the correct answer (or a lack thereof based on the options) could have been determined instantly without external tooling.
